description: This file implements the du_ue_manager class, which manages User Equipment (UE) contexts in a 5G DU (Distributed Unit) environment. It handles UE creation, deletion, configuration, reestablishment, and resource management, including interactions with procedures and asynchronous tasks.

classes.name: du_ue_manager
classes.description: Manages UE contexts, procedures, and resource allocation within a 5G DU environment.

methods.name: du_ue_manager
methods.description: Constructor initializing the UE manager with configuration, resource management, and cell management references.

methods.name: find_unused_du_ue_index
methods.description: Finds an unused UE index with no pending procedures or allocations.

methods.name: handle_ue_create_request
methods.description: Handles UE creation requests, enqueuing procedures or rejecting if no resources are available.

methods.name: handle_ue_config_request
methods.description: Handles UE configuration update requests asynchronously.

methods.name: handle_ue_drb_deactivation_request
methods.description: Handles deactivation requests for UE Data Radio Bearers.

methods.name: handle_reestablishment_request
methods.description: Handles UE reestablishment by copying old context and deleting the old UE context.

methods.name: handle_ue_config_applied
methods.description: Notifies that UE configuration has been applied and forwards to MAC.

methods.name: handle_ue_config_request
methods.description: Handles UE configuration control requests asynchronously.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Gracefully stops the UE manager, disconnecting UEs and cancelling procedures.

methods.name: find_ue
methods.description: Finds a UE by its index, mutable and const versions.

methods.name: find_rnti
methods.description: Finds a UE by its RNTI.

methods.name: find_f1ap_ue_id
methods.description: Finds a UE by its F1AP ID.

methods.name: add_ue
methods.description: Adds a new UE context if valid and not already existing.

methods.name: remove_ue
methods.description: Removes a UE context asynchronously, after pending procedures complete.

methods.name: update_crnti
methods.description: Updates the C-RNTI of a UE and maintains the RNTI-to-UE index map.
